_about: PLACEHOLDER lines for the night market's townsfolk and examine spots (VS-14), so every placed person and sign says something while the town is graybox. Whisper-market tone (docs/maps/night_market.md, Decision 1A): murmured, nervous, warm. The Writer replaces these with data/dialogue/market.json (same conversation ids or new ones; update slice/placements.json to match). Dialogue & writing is Level 0: Ross approves final words.

mk_sq_pop.speaker: mk_sq_pop
mk_sq_pop.text: Everyone eats here. Even them. ...Especially them.

mk_sq_dumpling.speaker: mk_sq_dumpling
mk_sq_dumpling.text: Sample? It is a little cold. ...Mm. Asleep. Sorry. Sample?

mk_sq_tape.speaker: mk_sq_tape
mk_sq_tape.text: Scrap wire by the foot. Tape by the mood. Whisper your length.

mk_sq_odds.speaker: mk_sq_odds
mk_sq_odds.text: Will the screen glitch before ten? Two rations says yes.

mk_sq_odds.speaker: mk_sq_odds
mk_sq_odds.text: I am right most days. That is the problem.

mk_sq_neighbor.speaker: mk_sq_neighbor
mk_sq_neighbor.text: You were out at all hours again. I bake at three. We are not so different.

mk_sq_neighbor.speaker: mk_sq_neighbor
mk_sq_neighbor.text: Keep it down. ...I said keep it down, I did not say stop.

mk_sq_ume.speaker: mk_sq_ume
mk_sq_ume.text: Phones, five minutes a bar. Do not touch the cords.

mk_sq_ume.speaker: mk_sq_ume
mk_sq_ume.text: I said do not touch the cords!

mk_sq_shopper_a.speaker: mk_sq_shopper_a
mk_sq_shopper_a.text: ...four for the price of three. Shh.

mk_sq_shopper_b.speaker: mk_sq_shopper_b
mk_sq_shopper_b.text: The screen is looking at us again. Pretend to browse.

mk_sq_shopper_c.speaker: mk_sq_shopper_c
mk_sq_shopper_c.text: Headphones. In my ears. Loud. In my head only.

mk_sq_shopper_d.speaker: mk_sq_shopper_d
mk_sq_shopper_d.text: Wind chimes are in socks this week. Do not ask me why.

mk_sq_wolf_b.speaker: mk_sq_wolf_b
mk_sq_wolf_b.text: ...Quiet hours, courier. Not that you were loud.

mk_wf_juno.speaker: mk_wf_juno
mk_wf_juno.text: Watch the track! Tuesday-class drones only. ...Mine crashes. Always the green one.

mk_wf_kid_a.speaker: mk_wf_kid_a
mk_wf_kid_a.text: Don't tell the patrol it is a race. It is a... delivery rehearsal.

mk_wf_judge.speaker: mk_wf_judge
mk_wf_judge.text: (whisper-shouting into the megaphone) FIRST. PLACE. Green one crashed.

mk_wf_pell.speaker: mk_wf_pell
mk_wf_pell.text: Hello, courier. Papers are my hobby. Ask me about papers, quietly.

mk_wf_late_cook.speaker: mk_wf_late_cook
mk_wf_late_cook.text: Pop's cousin. Same menu. Better view.

mk_gt_grunt_b.speaker: mk_gt_grunt_b
mk_gt_grunt_b.text: Noise ticket. One wind chime. Form 12. ...I did not write the rules. I write the tickets.

mk_gt_line_a.speaker: mk_gt_line_a
mk_gt_line_a.text: It's only a wind chime. In a sock.

mk_gt_line_c.speaker: mk_gt_line_c
mk_gt_line_c.text: Do not make eye contact with the searchlight.

mk_cs_keeper.speaker: mk_cs_keeper
mk_cs_keeper.text: Everything you need, nothing you want. The usual?

mk_cs_clerk.speaker: mk_cs_clerk
mk_cs_clerk.text: Antacids. Do not look at the badge. I am just a guy.

mk_fg_otis.speaker: mk_fg_otis
mk_fg_otis.text: Friend! Welcome. Mind the anvil. ...Sorry, anvil.

mk_fg_otis.speaker: mk_fg_otis
mk_fg_otis.text: Swords are on the wall. Ask, and I will tinker.

mk_rp_mox.speaker: mk_rp_mox
mk_rp_mox.text: Red! The deck is a hundred percent... forty percent finished. Tuesday, say hi. ...Tuesday?

mk_ar_owner.speaker: mk_ar_owner
mk_ar_owner.text: Socks on the speakers. House rule. Quiet Hours does not get to hear the game over.

mk_ar_kid_a.speaker: mk_ar_kid_a
mk_ar_kid_a.text: Beep. Beep beep. Beeeep. (That was a win.)

mk_ar_kid_b.speaker: mk_ar_kid_b
mk_ar_kid_b.text: Zed is one point ahead. I will fix that.

mk_ar_kid_c.speaker: mk_ar_kid_c
mk_ar_kid_c.text: Shhh, I'm on the last level.

mk_ar_zed.speaker: mk_ar_zed
mk_ar_zed.text: Nine thousand nine hundred ninety. ...You are at nine nine eight nine? One point. Always one point.

mk_gt_grunt_a_open.speaker: mk_gt_grunt_a
mk_gt_grunt_a_open.text: ...Pass is in order. Stamp, stamp. Boom's up. Do not make a noise on the road.

mk_dp_dispatcher_taken.speaker: mk_dp_dispatcher
mk_dp_dispatcher_taken.text: Yard 9. Gate 4, show the pass, mind the quiet. Why are you still here?

mk_dp_dispatcher_done.speaker: mk_dp_dispatcher
mk_dp_dispatcher_done.text: Stamped DONE. ...Everyone is talking about it, in whispers.

mk_dp_dispatcher.speaker: mk_dp_dispatcher
mk_dp_dispatcher.text: Job board is on the wall. Main job is the Yard 9 pickup. Do not dawdle, the deadline is already angry.

mk_sq_screen.speaker: narrator
mk_sq_screen.text: The Admiral's broadcast, looping. A scrolling memo underneath: 'KASP: QUIET HOURS ARE EVERY HOUR.'

mk_sq_phone_rack.speaker: narrator
mk_sq_phone_rack.text: A washing line of phones, all charging off Grandma Ume's window. Cords swing like vines.

mk_sq_window_ledge.speaker: narrator
mk_sq_window_ledge.text: Ume's window. A ledge under it, two crates to get up. The sill is warm.

mk_sq_tarp_pole.speaker: narrator
mk_sq_tarp_pole.text: The pole holds the tarps and a tangle of string lights. Somebody taped a tiny flag to it.

mk_sq_bets_board.speaker: narrator
mk_sq_bets_board.text: BETS: Will the screen glitch before ten? / Will Pop run out of broth? / Will the patrol smile? (odds: never)

mk_sq_memo_board.speaker: narrator
mk_sq_memo_board.text: Kasp's daily memo: 'Noise is a choice. Choose less.'

mk_wf_screen.speaker: narrator
mk_wf_screen.text: The Admiral's face with a sticker moustache. Somebody added eyebrows.

mk_wf_tide_board.speaker: narrator
mk_wf_tide_board.text: TIDE: in. Then out. Then in.

mk_wf_crane.speaker: narrator
mk_wf_crane.text: A crane silhouette. Still. Somebody hung a laundry line off the arm.

mk_wf_results.speaker: narrator
mk_wf_results.text: RACE RESULTS: 1st Tuesday-class (blue). 2nd Tuesday-class (red). Green: crashed, again.

mk_gt_appeals_slot.speaker: narrator
mk_gt_appeals_slot.text: APPEALS. A slot in the booth. A recorded voice: 'Your appeal is important to us.' Nothing to drop in it yet.

mk_gt_poster.speaker: narrator
mk_gt_poster.text: QUIET HOURS SAVE LIVES. Someone chalked a moustache on Kasp.

mk_hd_stickers.speaker: narrator
mk_hd_stickers.text: One sticker per delivery. The wall is nearly full.

mk_hd_photo.speaker: narrator
mk_hd_photo.text: Mom, young, grinning, in a flight jacket. Written on the back: 'Keep it down. Fly anyway.'

mk_hd_charts.speaker: narrator
mk_hd_charts.text: Mom's old flight charts. The lines go somewhere you can no longer fly.

mk_hd_parcel.speaker: narrator
mk_hd_parcel.text: A parcel marked 'MOX WUZ HERE'. Heavy. Ticks faintly. You leave it.

mk_rp_scratch.speaker: narrator
mk_rp_scratch.text: Scratched into the counter: MOX WUZ HERE. Underneath, smaller: 'and Tuesday.'

mk_fg_bridge_lamp.speaker: narrator
mk_fg_bridge_lamp.text: A rusty ship's bridge lamp, locked tight to the counter. Otis polishes it when he thinks nobody is looking.

mk_ar_scores.speaker: narrator
mk_ar_scores.text: HIGH SCORES: ZED 9990. RED 9989. A third line has been scratched out.

mk_wf_pell_done.speaker: mk_wf_pell
mk_wf_pell_done.text: Filed. They said my appeal is important to them. ...Nobody has said that to me in years.

mk_wf_pell_form.speaker: mk_wf_pell
mk_wf_pell_form.text: An Appeal Form! Signals hands out the tickets and never mentions the forms. You have to know somebody.

mk_wf_pell_form.speaker: mk_wf_pell
mk_wf_pell_form.text: Drop it in the APPEALS slot at Gate 4. In triplicate. Well, once. It is a start.

mk_wf_pell_go.speaker: mk_wf_pell
mk_wf_pell_go.text: Booth slot, Gate 4. Do not fold it. They hate it when you fold it.

mk_gt_appeals_done.speaker: narrator
mk_gt_appeals_done.text: The slot hums. A recorded voice: 'Your appeal is important to us.'

mk_sq_window_ledge_done.speaker: narrator
mk_sq_window_ledge_done.text: Ume's phones are charged. The window glows a bit warmer.

mk_charge_drop.speaker: narrator
mk_charge_drop.text: You set the battery brick on the sill. A phone on the line blinks awake. Ume's hand snatches the brick inside.

mk_charge_reward.speaker: mk_sq_ume
mk_charge_reward.text: Do not touch the cords! ...Thank you. The sill has something for you.

mk_appeal_drop.speaker: narrator
mk_appeal_drop.text: You slide the form into the APPEALS slot. It is eaten. A recorded voice: 'Your appeal is important to us.'

mk_appeal_paid.speaker: mk_wf_pell
mk_appeal_paid.text: (a note slides out of the slot) 'Filed. Payment attached.' ...Two rations and some credits.
